decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options based on sound output (wattage), durability (waterproof ratings), and overall consumer sentiment. The consideration set includes a high-end multi-room system (Sonos), a powerful mid-range rugged speaker (BOGASING), and several value-oriented portable options. I ultimately chose the INSMY Portable Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) because it offers the best balance of features: an IPX7 waterproof rating, 20W output, 24-hour battery life, and an exceptionally high rating of 4.6 across over 6,500 reviews, making it a very reliable purchase for its price point of $29.99.
